paired_timestamp_alignment.meaning: paired VIDEO-mode timestamp compared with ffprobe PTS for the same decoded frame index

confidence_weight: same >=0.2 visibility eligibility as canonical semantic-track conversion; then weighted by visibility

shared_weak_perspective_camera.assumption: one orthographic orientation fitted only on decoded track frames 1-53; frame-specific scale and 2D translation
shared_weak_perspective_camera.per_frame_free_fit_invariant: each free-orientation residual is constrained to be no worse than the shared orientation on that frame

per_frame_free_orientation.assumption: orthographic orientation optimized independently per frame with each frame scale and translation refit; higher-freedom diagnostic, not a calibrated camera

limits: Orthographic similarity only; no perspective intrinsics or distortion
Orientation coordinate search is a local numerical fit, not a camera calibration
World landmarks are model estimates, not independent ground truth
No retargeting, source-depth truth, or contact accuracy inferred
